entries.ea60f2e5f84c856d: The company's strength lies in a structure that allows the group to handle everything from manufacturing piles, poles and civil engineering products, through pile driving and ground improvement work, to product transport, built on 2 businesses: the Concrete Secondary Products Business (¥26,906 million) and the Foundation Business (¥22,013 million).
